config.description: The configuration file that was read, or null when there is none

name.description: The name in the configuration; also the producer suffix (`critic.<name>`)

type.description: `uiclip`, `llm`, `module`, or `not-configured` for a built-in critic that has no configuration yet

kind.description: `model`, `llm`, `heuristic`… as the critic says; null when it is not configured

status.description: `needs-setup`: run `atlas critic setup <name>`. `misconfigured`: the configuration or a credential reference cannot be used (see `detail`)

sendsImagesTo.description: Where images are sent: a host, or null when they never leave this machine. A run that sends images to a third party needs confirmation

detail.description: Why it is not ready, and what to do. Never holds a credential
